questions.question: Is lighting around the site adequate, inside and out, at all times of day?
Are eyewash stations staged in the right places, filled, and secured against tampering?
Are the eyewash stations inspected regularly?
Are all containers labeled with the manufacturer's label or proper handwritten information?
Are fire extinguishers staged properly: at each stair landing, 25 to 75 feet from flammable storage, within 100 feet of any work, and on all mobile equipment?
Are all fire extinguishers inspected monthly and tagged as current?
Are all flammable materials stored in the right places?
Do fuel storage areas have secondary and spill containment?
Are flammable storage cabinets grounded and within capacity?
Is the PTSA board up in an accessible spot, with a way to hold PTSAs for each sub or crew?
Are blank forms protected, available to crews, and well stocked?
Is there an accessible place for crews to turn in completed documents?
Is there a sign at the project entrance with the project address?
Does the project entrance have the right signage?
Are muster points marked with signs?
Is the OSHA board posted where it's visible, clean, legible, and up to date?
Is the right signage displayed around the site?
Is there at least one restroom for every ten people on site?

follow_up.any: How many people and how many restrooms are on site?

questions.question: Are restrooms clean and stocked?
Is there a hand washing or sanitizing station at every restroom?
Are all workers wearing minimum PPE: helmet, glasses, gloves, high-vis, and work boots?
Do workers doing special tasks, like hot work or overhead work, have the right PPE?
Are people with prescription glasses wearing Z87 rated glasses or Z87 overglasses?
Is everyone wearing gloves from the Clayco Glove Guide that fit their task?

follow_up.No: Who doesn't have the right gloves?

questions.question: Are workers making flying debris wearing foam-lined glasses or goggles and face shields?
Are people working with sharp sheet metal or similar wearing cut-rated sleeves?
Are all tools used properly with safeguards in place and working?
Are all knives on site the automatic self-retracting type?
Are all cords in good shape with GFCI protection at the power source?
Are extension cords in good shape, raised at least 7 feet on non-conductive supports, or rolled up when not in use?
Is material secured when saws and grinders are used?
Are all hand-held bandsaws on site dual-trigger?
Do all drills with a half inch or larger chuck, except hammer drills, have auto-stop or anti-rotation?
Is it warm enough to need Chill Zones, 80 degrees or more with the heat index?

follow_up.Yes: How many Chill Zones are set up?

questions.question: Are the Chill Zones set up with water, shade, and seats?
Is it cold enough to need Warm Zones?

follow_up.Yes: How many Warm Zones are set up?
